request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Recolour only the goblin: his bright green skin becomes olive green, colour #8a952f with #495508 shadows; his orange cap becomes dull brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows. Shorten his right ear so nothing reaches past the cart's right side. Keep everything else exactly the same: his face, eyes and grin, the five paper rockets, the dull dark brown cart and wheels, sticks, rope, thick black outline and art style.
